infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OutdoorAdvisor needs your location to show air quality and weather for your area.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: OutdoorAdvisor uses your location to show weather, air quality, and pollen data for your area, and to deliver timely outdoor condition alerts in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: OutdoorAdvisor uses your location in the background to deliver timely outdoor condition and air quality alerts.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: OutdoorAdvisor reads your steps, walking distance, and activity energy to time smart outdoor walk suggestions.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: OutdoorAdvisor does not write health data, but iOS requires a Health access description for this integration.
